name: Teamly
description_en:
Teamly combines remote-team task boards with chat, shared files, operating procedures, time tracking and screen capture in its Business offering. Its separate Capture product handles recorded explanations and screenshots; a free Capture account does not establish a free team-management plan.

The practical choice is whether a team wants those communication and monitoring tools alongside its workflow board. The documentation supports specific task, permission and billing behavior, while current pricing and older sales terms disagree in material places. This profile preserves those differences rather than treating a marketing bundle as a tested operational guarantee.
description_zh:
Teamly 的 Business 产品把远程团队任务看板与聊天、共享文件、操作规程、工时及屏幕录制组合在一起；独立的 Capture 产品用于录制说明和截图。Capture 免费账户不证明团队管理套餐免费。

实际选型问题是：团队是否需要在流程看板旁同时使用沟通和监测工具。文档支持具体任务、权限和计费规则，但当前价格页与旧销售条款有实质差异。本档案保留这些差异，不把营销组合当作经过实测的运营保证。

core_features.explanation_en: Move task cards between work-stage columns and inspect assignees, labels and dates.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在工作阶段列之间移动任务卡，检查负责人、标签及日期。

core_features.explanation_en: Automatic tracking and separately controlled manual entries coexist with employee monitoring.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自动计时与单独受控的手工录入并存，并提供员工监测。

core_features.name_zh: 受管理的 SOP 文档
core_features.explanation_en: Owners and admins create procedures from a blank file or a template.
core_features.explanation_zh: 所有者和管理员从空白文档或模板创建规程。

en: Evaluate a staged remote-team handoff with one task board, a maintained SOP and separately agreed time records.
zh: 用一个任务看板、有人维护的 SOP 及另行约定的工时记录评估远程团队分阶段交接。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation, not a customer example or hands-on test.

Client and service scope.en: Current product navigation advertises Mac and PC compatibility. Download/install rights do not establish a self-hosted backend, an offline mode or Linux support.
Client and service scope.zh: 当前产品导航标注 Mac 和 PC 兼容；下载／安装权不证明可自托管后端、离线模式或 Linux 支持。

steps.en: Select Business scope and confirm included users, trial conversion and the actual checkout before inviting a team.
steps.zh: 邀请团队前，选择 Business 范围并确认包含用户、试用转付费及真实结账条件。

steps.en: Agree on one board handoff, owner/admin SOP maintenance and permitted time logging; verify them with non-sensitive sample work.
steps.zh: 约定一个看板交接、所有者／管理员的 SOP 维护及允许的工时录入，用非敏感样本核对。

integrations.scope: Built-in product bundle read; external connector/API catalog and bidirectional behavior not established.

items.en: Free Capture is single-user recording scope; a sustained-free Business workspace was not established.
items.zh: 免费 Capture 属于单用户录制范围，未确立持续免费的 Business 工作区。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Choose the team workspace, not just the recording app
sections.title_zh: 先确认团队工作区与录制工具的范围
sections.en:
Business is the relevant scope for managing team work: the official product navigation groups workflow boards, chat, storage, documents and time tracking there. Capture remains a separate recording product and is included in Business.

This matters when comparing costs. A person sending a short visual explanation may only need Capture; coordinating assignments and staff time requires assessing Business. A shared brand is not evidence that every download exposes the same workspace capabilities.
sections.zh:
Business 才是管理团队工作的相关范围：官方产品导航把流程看板、聊天、存储、文档及工时归入其中。Capture 仍是独立录制产品，并被 Business 包含。

这会影响费用比较。个人发送简短可视说明可能只需 Capture；协调分工及员工工时则需评估 Business。共用品牌不证明每种下载都开放相同工作区能力。

sections.title_en: Make the handoff visible in a board
sections.en:
For a proposed content-review board, create separate columns for drafting, review and completion. Put one deliverable on a card, give it a responsible person and date, and use a label for a review condition. Moving the card should mean that the agreed handoff happened; it does not itself prove that an external publication succeeded.

Teamly documents task discussion, sorting by dates/labels/users and alternative views. Start with one workflow and agree on what each column means before adding more projects. This example is editorial guidance, not a board created or tested for this research.
sections.zh:
假设建立内容复核看板，可分草稿、复核及完成三列，一个交付物一张卡，设置负责人及日期，再用标签标注复核条件。移动卡片应表示约定交接已经发生，本身不证明外部发布成功。

Teamly 文档描述任务讨论、按日期／标签／用户排序及不同视图。增加项目之前，先从一个流程开始并约定各列含义。本例是编辑建议，未在本研究中创建或测试看板。

sections.title_en: Observe rules before relying on reminders
sections.title_zh: 依赖提醒前先检查规则
sections.en:
The automation help page locates the rule list under Workflows, Board view, then Automations. It exposes status, name and creation date, providing a place to inspect whether a rule exists and is enabled.

A deadline notification can support a handoff, but the read documentation does not establish delivery guarantees, replay semantics, quota exhaustion behavior or an external integration trigger catalog. Check the intended rule with a disposable task, inspect the recipient and expected notification, and agree on a manual follow-up when it does not arrive.
sections.zh:
自动化帮助页把规则列表放在 Workflows 的 Board 视图下，进入 Automations 可查看状态、名称及创建日期，据此检查规则是否存在及启用。

截止提醒可以辅助交接，但所读文档没有确立送达保证、重放语义、额度耗尽行为或外部集成触发器目录。可用可丢弃任务核对目标规则、接收者及预期提醒，并约定未送达时的人工跟进。

sections.title_en: Time logging and screen capture need separate decisions
sections.title_zh: 工时录入与屏幕采集需分别决定
sections.en:
The time-permission article allows owners, admins and managers to control whether an individual can enter manual work time; that permission is enabled by default. Manual entries should therefore not be mistaken for automatically observed activity.

A separate support article specifies screenshots every ten minutes while tracking. Before using time reports for a team process, establish who tracks what, what monitoring is enabled and who can view the records. This is a documented cadence, not proof that every interval produces a complete or accurate account of work. The screen-capture toggle article did not return a readable body in this session, so its detailed current control behavior remains unverified.
sections.zh:
工时权限文章允许所有者、管理员及经理控制某人是否可手工录入工时，该权限默认开启。因此不能把手工条目误当作自动观察的活动。

另一篇支持文档说明计时时每十分钟截图一次。将报告用于团队流程前，应约定计时对象、启用的监测及记录查看者。这是文档规定的频率，不证明每个间隔都完整准确反映工作。本次未读到屏幕采集开关文章的正文，详细现行控制行为仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Write procedures with the people who can maintain them
sections.title_zh: 由具备维护权限的人编写规程
sections.en:
Teamly Docs uses SOP files with a blank-file path and supplied templates. Owners and admins can create and manage them, add supporting material, save a file and use a publish control.

For an onboarding procedure, nominate the maintainer and distinguish an unfinished edit from the version teammates should follow. Access to a task board does not establish SOP editing authority. Version history, conflict recovery and a complete portable export were not established by the read creation guide, so validate those separately before treating Docs as the sole procedural archive.
sections.zh:
Teamly Docs 使用 SOP 文件，可从空白文件或已有模板创建。所有者和管理员可创建、管理、添加辅助材料、保存文件并使用发布控件。

以入职规程为例，应明确维护人，区分未完成编辑与成员应遵循的版本。能访问任务看板不证明有 SOP 编辑权限。所读创建指南没有确立版本历史、冲突恢复及完整可移植导出；把 Docs 当作唯一规程档案前需分别验证。

sections.title_en: Budget by bundle, then reconcile the checkout
sections.title_zh: 按产品组合预算，再核对结账条款
sections.en:
The current Business page displays US$27 monthly or US$17 per month billed annually, with five included users, five workflows and 1,000 automation uses per month. Business+ Level 1 displays US$47 monthly or US$37 per month billed annually with fifteen users. Higher levels are separately selectable; their current prices were not verified.

Capture Starter is free for one user, with 200 MB storage and three-month storage time. This is a narrower product. Older sales terms still show different Pro/Business names and prices, while the current pricing FAQ includes upgrades in its thirty-day refund wording and the sales terms specify initial purchase. The terms require trial cancellation at least twenty-four hours before expiry and describe recurring charges. Preserve the checkout amount and applicable conditions before subscribing; neither page inconsistency is resolved by selecting the cheaper statement.
sections.zh:
当前 Business 页显示月付 US$27，或按年计费折合每月 US$17，包含五位用户、五个流程及每月 1,000 次自动化使用。Business+ Level 1 为月付 US$47，或按年计费折合每月 US$37，包含十五位用户。更高等级另行选择，本次未核实其现价。

Capture Starter 为单用户免费版，存储 200 MB，存储时长三个月，属于范围较窄的产品。旧销售条款仍显示不同 Pro／Business 名称及价格；当前价格 FAQ 的三十天退款包括升级，而销售条款限定首次购买。条款要求在试用到期至少二十四小时前取消，并描述循环扣费。订阅前应留存结账金额及适用条件，不能通过挑选较便宜的表述消除页面冲突。

sections.title_en: A downloadable client is not a self-hosting license
sections.title_zh: 可下载客户端不等于自托管许可
sections.en:
The EULA grants a limited, revocable, nontransferable right to install and use the software for permitted purposes. Its restrictions address outside-business access and incorporating the software into another product. The read sources do not establish a reusable application source license or a supported self-hostable service.

Business is worth evaluating for teams that want workflow communication, procedures and time records together. A personal checklist, guaranteed delivery system or independent source-controlled backend has different requirements. Before a broad rollout, verify account permissions, a sample task handoff, monitoring settings and an exit copy of important files. These are proposed acceptance steps; no account, recording, timer or payment operation was performed.
sections.zh:
EULA 授予限定、可撤销、不可转让的软件安装及允许用途使用权，限制涉及企业外访问及把软件纳入其他产品。所读来源没有确立可复用应用源码许可或受支持的自托管服务。

希望集中流程沟通、规程及工时记录的团队可评估 Business；个人检查表、保证送达系统或独立受源码控制的后端有不同要求。广泛使用前，应核对账户权限、样本任务交接、监测设置及重要文件的退出副本。这些是建议验收步骤，未执行账户、录制、计时或付款操作。

seo.title_en: Teamly Business: Workflow Boards, Monitoring and Bundle Costs
seo.title_zh: Teamly Business：流程看板、监测与组合费用
seo.description_en: Examine the Capture/Business boundary, board handoffs, SOP roles, manual time and current prices that differ from older terms.
seo.description_zh: 核对 Capture／Business 边界、看板交接、SOP 角色、手工工时及与旧条款不同的现价。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Teamly team-management scope and operating conditions.
secondary_questions: Does free Capture include a free team workspace?
Who can maintain SOPs and enter manual time?
seo.query_basis: Editorial hypotheses; no measured search demand or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No account, invitation, role change, board action, notification, timer, screenshot/recording, export/restore, purchase or cancellation was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、邀请、角色修改、看板操作、提醒、计时、截图／录制、导出／恢复、购买或取消。

research_gaps.en: Custom automation and screen-capture-toggle pages did not yield readable bodies. Retry/idempotence/quota failure handling, full permission matrix, offline operation, export completeness and disaster recovery remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 自定义自动化及屏幕采集开关页未返回可读正文。重试／幂等／额度失败处理、完整权限表、离线操作、导出完整性及灾难恢复未核实。

research_gaps.en: Current checkout, higher Business+ level prices, taxes and conflicts with older sales terms need confirmation. Business transcription allowance differs between its pricing table and Capture FAQ; not normalized into a guaranteed quota.
research_gaps.zh: 现行结账、更高 Business+ 等级价格、税及旧销售条款冲突需确认。Business 转录额度在自身价格表与 Capture FAQ 间不同，未归一为保证额度。
